_meta.purpose: 3-way category probe: B = 'standing concession' entitlement framing, C = pure follow-up (no offer). Both submitted UTILITY to see which holds.

templates._label: B. UTILITY — 'standing concession' entitlement, no number/deadline (borderline; best utility odds)
templates.name: abnormal_recheck_standing_concession

components.text:
Hi {{1}}, a follow-up from Sobhana Diagnostics.

Your {{2}} results were outside the normal range and a repeat test is advised.

As a returning patient, your standing concession applies to this test. Reply *'BOOK'* for the details about your concession and to arrange a convenient time.

If you have already completed these tests elsewhere, you may ignore this reminder.

templates._label: C. UTILITY — pure follow-up, no offer word at all (discount lives only in the reply window)
templates.name: abnormal_recheck_followup

components.text:
Hi {{1}}, a follow-up from Sobhana Diagnostics. Your {{2}} results were outside the normal range and a repeat test is recommended to track your health. Reply BOOK and we will arrange a convenient time for you.

If you have already completed these tests elsewhere, you may ignore this reminder.
